Marta: Quick: 30m sparring tomorrow 9:30 PT to finalize launch battlecard + bench language. Targets: 2 defensible bench lines, 3 SDR hooks, 1 rebut cheat. In? :crossed_swords:
Eli: In. I'll pull the latest latency/cost deltas vs managed APIs and cloud endpoints (128/512 token profiles).
Grace: I'll bring P50/P95 traces and the canary CSVs for quantized runs. Will flag configs used.
Owen: Drafting a compact competitor grid: where they win vs where we win (latency, cost, rollout friction, private deploy).
Tess: SDR hooks should be <20 words. Propose PLG, AE, and Tech variants. Also want A/B plan for 50-send tests.
Marta: Sample hooks to iterate:
  PLG: "Ship chat features faster: predictable latency + lower per-interaction spend across deploy modes."
  AE: "SLA-backed inference with private deploys and dedicated capacity  production-ready."
  Tech: "Runtime batching + KV cache + quant-friendly kernels = lower unit cost, preserved latency."
Eli: Bench phrasing: avoid absolutes. Use qualifiers + appendix. e.g. "In our benchmark, up to 3-4x lower unit cost under typical chat loads; see appendix."
Grace: FYI staging medians at 512: Redwood ~22-28ms depending on model, CloudV ~95-130ms. Cost delta varies with quant & batch. Attaching CSVs to pre-read.
Owen: Rebut matrix should address: "We already use CloudV", "We need SLA guarantees", "We can't host private infra"  each with 1-line rebut + 1 supporting datapoint.
Tess: Example rebut to "We already use CloudV": "They handle scale; we give predictable tail latency and runtime-level unit-cost controls, plus an easy migration path to dedicated/private."
sd-bot: Calendar invite created for 09:30-10:00 PT. Pre-read link: https://notion.company/redwood/bench-sparring-1839990000
Marta: Inbound routing rule for demo requests: if body matches /(latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput|predictable)/i -> tag: enterprise-sales, else -> growth-inbound. Can SDR ops implement?
Eli: Also capture phrases: "tail latency", "consistent latency", and "token spend" for better triage.
Grace: Action items: Grace -> bench CSVs + appendix; Owen -> 1-slide competitor grid + rebut cheat; Tess -> SDR hooks + A/B plan; Eli -> cleaned benchmark language. I'll run the sparring and collate outputs.
Marta: Reminder: keep public messaging conservative and always link to the appendix for numbers. We'll finalize copy post-sparring and hand off a one-pager to SDRs by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
